CREATE TABLE %PREFIX%_event_attendance_locks ( eal_id integer unsigned NOT NULL AUTO_INCREMENT, eal_tracker_id integer unsigned NOT NULL, eal_event_uuid varchar(36) NOT NULL, eal_usr_id integer unsigned NOT NULL, eal_token varchar(64) NOT NULL, eal_expires_at timestamp NOT NULL, eal_timestamp_change timestamp NOT NULL DEFAULT CURRENT_TIMESTAMP, PRIMARY KEY (eal_id), CONSTRAINT %PREFIX%_fk_eal_tracker FOREIGN KEY (eal_tracker_id) REFERENCES %PREFIX%_event_attendance_trackers (eat_id) ON DELETE CASCADE ON UPDATE RESTRICT, CONSTRAINT %PREFIX%_fk_eal_user FOREIGN KEY (eal_usr_id) REFERENCES %PREFIX%_users (usr_id) ON DELETE RESTRICT ON UPDATE RESTRICT )
